subject: how are the P-values of indirect and total effects of an exogenous varible calculated in lavaan?

messages.author: 53786f41e794363b
messages.subject: how are the P-values of indirect and total effects of an exogenous varible calculated in lavaan?
parts:
Hi all,

Nowadays I have checked planty of packages for SEM analysis. It seems that only the lavaan package can show the statistical significance (P-value) of the indirect and total effects of an exogenous varible. So I am quite curious about their methodological bases.

Cheers,
Bin

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: how are the P-values of indirect and total effects of an exogenous varible calculated in lavaan?
parts: It seems that only the lavaan package can show the statistical significance (P-value) of the indirect and total effects of an exogenous varible.
I know at least Mplus provides tests in the output when using the MODEL INDIRECT command in the input file.
So I am quite curious about their methodological bases.

Mplus (see Chapter 17 of the user manual) and lavaan both use the delta method by default to calculate SEs, and bootstrap SEs are also also available.

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/mediation.html
